# Agent Call Trace Sync, Re-Bid Iteration Fix & Test Ticket Scenarios  ## Problem Summary  1. **Agent Call Trace dashboard is not syncing with Market View** — when a ticket is executed via the Market view (Ticket Intake → inject), the trace data doesn't reliably appear in the Agent Call Trace dashboard. 2. **Re-bid iteration logic has a bug** — `evaluate_coverage()` in `vetting.py` expects a `dict | str` but the orchestrator passes a **list** (`accumulated_evidence`), causing the vetting to `str()` the entire list instead of properly extracting evidence fields. This means coverage scores may be artificially inflated, preventing proper re-bids. 3. **Test ticket scenarios needed** — user wants to test tickets where different agents win the auction and collaborate.  ## Proposed Changes  ---  ### 1. Backend: Fix `evaluate_coverage` List Handling  #### [MODIFY] [vetting.py](file:///c:/Users/Kanishk/Desktop/Agents-Infinity-Assemble-all-agents-communicating/vetting.py)  The `evaluate_coverage` function signature says `evidence_trail: dict | str` but the orchestrator passes a **list** of result dicts (`accumulated_evidence`). When it falls through to `str(evidence_trail)`, the stringified list includes Python repr noise. Fix:  - Add an `isinstance(evidence_trail, list)` branch that iterates through the list and concatenates all diagnosis, actions, statements, state_before_after, and collaboration_result fields from each evidence dict into a single search corpus.  ---  ### 2. Backend: Dispatcher API Endpoint Fixes  #### [MODIFY] [dispatcher.py](file:///c:/Users/Kanishk/Desktop/Agents-Infinity-Assemble-all-agents-communicating/dispatcher.py)  **Issues found:** - The `inject_ticket` endpoint always defaults `order_id` to `"O-1001"` and `customer_id` to `"C001"`. For tickets involving different scenarios (billing refund rejection, account lock, subscription cancellation), the orchestrator needs the correct order/customer mappings. Add a smart auto-detect that maps ticket text keywords to the appropriate order/customer from `shared_data.ORDERS` and `shared_data.CUSTOMERS`. - The `/agent_trace` endpoint doesn't include the `ticket_text` in its `executed_tickets_summary`, making it impossible for the trace dashboard to show what ticket was about. - Add a new `/inject_and_trace` endpoint that injects a ticket AND immediately returns both the execution result AND the updated trace logs in a single response — this eliminates the race condition where the frontend calls `/inject_ticket` and then polls `/agent_trace` before the trace data is written.  ---  ### 3. Frontend: Sync Trace Dashboard with Market Executions  #### [MODIFY] [App.jsx](file:///c:/Users/Kanishk/Desktop/Agents-Infinity-Assemble-all-agents-communicating/frontend/src/App.jsx)  - After `handleAddTicket` completes and gets a backend response, immediately call `syncBackendData()` to refresh trace logs. Currently this is done but the trace dashboard may not reflect the update because the user might be on the 'market' view. Fix: store the latest execution result and auto-switch or show a notification. - When a ticket is injected from the market view, store the execution trace_steps from the response directly into `traceLogs` state immediately (don't wait for the next poll cycle).  #### [MODIFY] [auctionBackend.js](file:///c:/Users/Kanishk/Desktop/Agents-Infinity-Assemble-all-agents-communicating/frontend/src/services/auctionBackend.js)  - Add a new `injectAndTrace` function that calls the new `/inject_and_trace` endpoint.  #### [MODIFY] [AgentCallTraceDashboard.jsx](file:///c:/Users/Kanishk/Desktop/Agents-Infinity-Assemble-all-agents-communicating/frontend/src/components/AgentCallTraceDashboard.jsx)  - Add `ticket_text` display in the executed tickets summary cards. - When trace logs are empty and the dashboard loads, show a clear empty state with instructions to submit a ticket from the Market View first.  ---  ### 4. Backend: Test Ticket Scenarios  #### [MODIFY] [dispatcher.py](file:///c:/Users/Kanishk/Desktop/Agents-Infinity-Assemble-all-agents-communicating/dispatcher.py)  Add a new `GET /test_tickets` endpoint that returns pre-built test ticket texts the user can copy-paste. These exercise all three agent types and collaboration scenarios:  | # | Ticket Text | Expected Winner | Collaboration? | |---|---|---|---| | 1 | "My refund hasn't shown up yet, it's been 2 days, please check the payment." | billing_agent | No | | 2 | "I cannot log into my account at all! It keeps saying my account is locked." | technical_agent | No | | 3 | "I have been a customer for 3 years and I've had so many issues recently. I want to cancel my subscription!" | retention_agent | Yes (billing) | | 4 | "My item was marked for return and refund but it's no longer visible in my orders dashboard. I want my money back." | billing_agent | Yes (technical) | | 5 | "I was charged twice for the same order. Please refund the duplicate charge." | billing_agent | No | | 6 | "My invoice was never generated for my order. I need a receipt for my records." | billing_agent | No |  > [!NOTE] > The market view is working well and will NOT be touched. All changes are to the backend dispatcher/vetting and the Agent Call Trace dashboard only.  ## Verification Plan  ### Automated Tests - `curl http://localhost:8000/health` to verify backend is up. - `curl http://localhost:8000/test_tickets` to verify test ticket endpoint. - Inject each test ticket via `curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/inject_and_trace` and verify the response contains both execution results and trace logs. - `npm run build` to verify frontend compiles.  ### Manual Verification - Submit each test ticket from the Market View and verify the Agent Call Trace dashboard shows the corresponding trace immediately.
